title: Yesterday's Interviews for Today's Engineers: Retrospective Perceptions and a Work-Aligned Hiring Framework (2005-2026)
abstract: arXiv:2609.14046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Technical hiring has increasingly become a skill system of its own, requiring candidates to prepare for processes that only partially resemble the position being filled. This paper reconstructs how the software-engineering community remembers that process across four eras from 2005 to 2026. Retrospective ratings from 911 respondents show a history of expanding interview work and burden, while an analysis of public preparation questions finds that most tested knowledge has a plausible use in an ordinary software-engineering project. The contradiction is only apparent: relevant topics can still form an invalid process when they are accumulated beyond the vacancy, presented under artificial constraints, or selected and interpreted without a common job-derived standard. The paper responds with the Ticket-Based Pragmatic Assessment Framework, a prescriptive reference framework that derives a bounded assessment from declared responsibilities,

translated_title: 为今日工程师准备的昨日面试：回溯性认知与工作对齐的招聘框架（2005-2026）
translated_abstract: 技术招聘日益演变成一个自成体系的技能系统，要求候选人为那些与所聘职位仅有部分相似度的流程做准备。本文重构了软件工程界在2005年至2026年四个时代中对这一流程的集体记忆。来自911名受访者的回溯性评分显示了一段面试工作量与负担不断扩大的历史，而对公开备考题目的分析则发现，大多数被考察的知识在普通软件工程项目中都具有合理的用途。这一矛盾只是表象：当相关的考察主题被积累到超出职位空缺所需、在人为约束条件下呈现、或在缺乏统一的源自职位的标准下进行选择和解读时，它们仍可能构成一个无效的流程。作为回应，本文提出了基于工单的务实评估框架，这是一个规范性参考框架，能够从声明的职责中推导出有边界的评估。
tldr: 本文通过对911名受访者的回溯性研究揭示了2005至2026年间技术面试负担不断膨胀却与实际工作脱节的矛盾，并提出基于工单的务实评估框架，从职位职责出发构建有边界、与工作对齐的招聘评估。
en_tdlr: Based on retrospective data from 911 respondents, this paper reveals the contradiction of ever-expanding interview burdens misaligned with actual work from 2005-2026, and proposes the Ticket-Based Pragmatic Assessment Framework to derive bounded, work-aligned hiring assessments from declared job responsibilities.
